entities.name: Creation of New Phyrexia
entities.description: The climactic end of the Mirran-Phyrexian War in 4557 AR, when Mirrodin was overtaken by Phyrexians and remade into nine biomechanical spheres.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial metallic plane created by Karn as Argentum, renamed Mirrodin after Memnarch's corruption, and transformed into New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem and planeswalker who created Argentum; his spark faded after the Mending and he was captured by Glissa and Tezzeret.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Figure whose corruption led to Argentum being renamed Mirrodin.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: A self-replicating Phyrexian agent inadvertently brought by Karn that spread and corrupted the plane from within.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: Planeswalker who led the surviving Mirrans in the Mirran Resistance and drew Elspeth and Venser to the plane.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: The surviving Mirrans, including sylvok, vulshok, leonin and elves, who fought on from hidden refuges.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Held Karn in the plane's core together with Tezzeret to hasten Phyrexia's rebirth.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Held Karn in the plane's core together with Glissa.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker drawn to Mirrodin by Koth who joined the search for Karn and helped lead the defense.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Planeswalker who sacrificed himself to restore Karn's spark and mind.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin whose corruption Phyrexians used to weaken the surface.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: Praetor faction of New Phyrexia led by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor leading the Machine Orthodoxy.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: Praetor faction of New Phyrexia led by Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Praetor leading the Progress Engine.

entities.name: Vicious Swarm
entities.description: Praetor faction of New Phyrexia led by Vorinclex.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Praetor leading the Vicious Swarm.

entities.name: Seven Steel Thanes
entities.description: Praetor faction of New Phyrexia led by Sheoldred.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Praetor leading the Seven Steel Thanes.

entities.name: Quiet Furnace
entities.description: Praetor faction of New Phyrexia led by Urabrask.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Praetor leading the Quiet Furnace.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who overtook Mirrodin and compleated its inhabitants.

events.summary: Phyrexians overtake Mirrodin in 4557 AR, ending the Mirran-Phyrexian War.
events.quote: when the plane of Mirrodin was overtaken by Phyrexians

events.summary: Koth leads the surviving Mirrans in forming the Mirran Resistance.
events.quote: the surviving Mirrans, led by Koth of the Hammer , formed the Mirran Resistance

events.summary: Karn's spark fades after the Mending, leaving him vulnerable to the oil.
events.quote: Karn’s Planeswalker spark faded, leaving him vulnerable to the oil's influence

events.summary: Glissa and Tezzeret capture Karn and hold him in the plane's core.
events.quote: he was captured and held in the plane's core by Glissa and Tezzeret

events.summary: Elspeth Tirel and Venser, drawn by Koth, join the search for Karn and the defense.
events.quote: joined the search for Karn and helped lead the defense

events.summary: Venser sacrifices himself to restore Karn's spark and mind, letting Karn reject Phyrexian influence and escape.
events.quote: Venser sacrificed himself to restore Karn’s spark and mind

events.summary: The Phyrexians win and remake the plane as New Phyrexia, nine spheres each ruled by a praetor faction.
events.quote: The plane was fully seized and transformed into New Phyrexia

events.summary: Native flora and fauna are forcibly compleated while the Mirran Resistance fights on from hidden refuges.
events.quote: continued to fight from hidden refuges within the deeper spheres
